verdict.rationale: Apify supports event-driven automation via webhooks that trigger actions (e.g., HTTP requests or starting another Actor) when platform events like run finish/fail occur, plus scheduled triggers ("Automatically start Actors and saved tasks at specific times"), covering rule-based automatic actions on events. Missing for 10: no evidence of more complex conditional rule logic (e.g., multi-condition triggers) or a visual rule-builder UI beyond webhooks/schedules, and no independent hands-on validation of webhook reliability.
